advancement_representation.full_partition_transition: UNRESOLVED; independent rigid rotations do not define shared-boundary/contact/gap/overlap treatment

t0_geometry_diagnostics.support_limit: Grid-edge segment statistics describe the constructed 1-degree support, not subgrid geological boundary resolution

topology_contact_guard.reason: Existing shared interfaces have convergent and divergent relative motion, but no law/backend resolves how rigidly moved neighboring plate polygons retain a valid complete partition, detect contact/crossing, or represent opening without inventing oceanic domain. A smaller positive dt does not itself define this missing transition.

event_localization.fixture_kernel: Exact constant-rate threshold time is algebraically localizable; production event acceptance tolerance is absent

dt_derivation.required_rule: minimum of active, valid, positive limits
dt_derivation.explanation: No positive dt can be certified until a shared-boundary/topology/contact transition rule and its acceptance checks exist. Do not substitute the conditional rift horizon for that rule.

other_event_guards.rift: Conditional positive model horizon; no event executed
other_event_guards.collision_or_contact_transition: UNRESOLVED; contact already exists at t0 and collision law/geometry semantics are not bound

after_each_accepted_step: validate spherical geometry and complete partition
recompute boundary geometry and relative drivers
select the next dt from current active limits
reject_step_on: event threshold crossed without localized event

if_later_authorized_evolved_fields: derived 1-degree plate/land raster where land support permits
state_and_output_semantics.land_identity: Preserve inherited land/crust identity; raster occupancy is derived only after valid topology is resolved
state_and_output_semantics.checkpoint_vs_snapshot: Distinct artifacts. Each accepted global-base physical checkpoint should emit a separately queryable snapshot; solver internals belong only in restart checkpoint, not history snapshot. Neither is created in this blocked task.
state_and_output_semantics.rasterization: After each accepted physical checkpoint, deterministic derived 1-degree materialization; never drives master geometry or claims finer support

performance_estimate.work_scale: O(12 plate transforms + 64800 faces / about 324000 closed-ring coordinate records)
performance_estimate.runtime_class: CPU-light geometric transform expected; NOT benchmarked
performance_estimate.working_memory_class: single-digit to low tens of MiB for float64 point arrays; NOT benchmarked
performance_estimate.checkpoint_size: same order as vector payload plus process and provenance state; NOT measured
